decision.winner: Concept 2: MedX: Every word, understood. (Apple-style product launch)

concepts.title: Every Word Arrived
concepts.notes: Strongest emotional spine: one Thai sentence that breaks apart at the start and holds together at the end. Weaknesses: the Thai line was invented ("ฉันแพ้ยาเพนิซิลลิน") and the Italian line "Ha allergie?" is not in the app. The CTA appears only at 55.8 s. Sixteen bespoke shots plus a 400-particle Thai glyph system make it a heavy one-day build. The thread implies one Thai case, but the stills come from several English demo cases (B-012, B-013, B-014).

concepts.title: MedX: Every word, understood. (product launch)
concepts.notes: Best match to the owner brief (Apple-launch pacing, a silent breath before the bloom reveal, the journey rail as a progress device). The CTA runs for 10 s with the QR code. Its normalized crops check out against the real stills (consult-full considerations and live summary match exactly) and it keeps the red Rule-out cards out of frame. Weakness: the hook (one question in three languages) is clear but low on emotion.

concepts.title: Fin Prepares. People Decide.
concepts.notes: Trust-first positioning matches the README ("a helper that listens closely, never the decider"). The safety metaphors (light gate, dual-key seal, ledger) are premium but take time to decode at this pace. The cold open is English-only, so the multilingual point is lost. Volumetric god-rays and 3D seals are the heaviest build. The concept text reached this judge truncated after its third shot (about 8.4 s), so it was scored on angle, logline and shots 1-3.

fromConcept1: Thai-sentence spine: the cold open breaks apart (S01), the line re-forms as the Thai pickup line (S13), and the callback holds and becomes a sourced chip (S16)
Fin's sound arcs morph into the lockup's arcs at the reveal (S04)
'Synthetic demo data' micro-tag on every UI shot
Six rising pentatonic plucks, one per check (S12)
Calm low two-tone alert, never a siren
Piano motif that hangs unresolved at 0:02 and resolves at 0:48
Gradient end card with a white lockup
fromConcept3: Rack focus on the key clause, plus the app's dotted evidence underline (S01, S16)
Light gate in front of the model nodes for 'red-flag rules run before any model' (S14)
Dual-key seal for the two-person check (S12)
'Fin prepares. People decide.' became 'MedX prepares. People decide.' (S15) because Fin is not on screen in the trust band

Invented Italian replaced with the real app string "Che cosa la porta qui oggi?"
Only the fin3d-* render family is used (it matches the Fin inside the patient app). fin-hello/fin-wave are a different render style and would read as a second mascot

Cropped out: the trace legend (red 'Escalated' swatch) and the ungrammatical '1 human decisions'; 'burning urination' in consult.webp (another case); the partial-vitals bullets in nurse-case.webp; the sticky sign-off bar; all B-0xx and F-206 case codes except the patient's own pickup code B-042
The 49.1% bar is white, not brand teal (the brand should not read as harm) and not red
No Gemma / AMD / model-accuracy claim anywhere (pitch/VIDEO-SCRIPT.md rule: never say Gemma on AMD over mock-model footage)

grid.rule: Every shot boundary is on the 0.5 s beat grid. Major hits (8.0 reveal, 12.0 groove, 28.0 safety dip, 32.0 groove return, 36.0 chorus, 42.0 breakdown, 50.0 final chorus, 54.0 end impact) are on 2.0 s bar lines. Frame for time t = round(t * 60).

_rules: Copy every file to C:\Users\User\medx-tools\promo\assets\<group>\<same file name>, and load ONLY through this map (assets.js generated from it), so the 2x refresh re-renders by dropping files in under the same names.
Crops are NORMALIZED [x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions of the source image, so 2x captures still line up. Re-check every crop by eye after the refresh.
Do not upscale a 1x still past 1.4x its native pixels. If a crop must be larger, wait for the 2x capture or use the listed CSS fallback (tokens plus the exact same words).
blur regions get a 10 px gaussian blur plus 40% mist overlay so codes are unreadable.
Crops verified by eye on 2026-10-18 against the current stills (contact sheet); re-verify after the 2x refresh.

compliance: Claim line 'Research prototype · Synthetic data · Not a medical device' is on screen 55.6-60.0 s, 24 px, white at 90% on the gradient, baseline about y 1030.

The statistic is verbatim from README.md 'Why', and the source line is on screen for the whole time the numbers are visible (4.5-7.75 s). The metric definition sits directly under the headline as the chart subtitle.
MedX verbs only: prepares, points back, flags, suggests, checks. Never: diagnoses, prescribes, decides urgency, AI doctor. No Gemma/AMD/accuracy claims.

Red (#BE1B2B family) appears only in S11: the app's own alert card plus one rim-light pulse at 28.6 s that fades out by 29.4. No red in the stat, the trace legend, the consult Rule-out cards or the rail.

Fin appears in S04, S17 and S18, and also inside the S13 patient pickup UI still (the app's own calm pickup card, a non-alert context). Never in S11, S14 or S15 (red-flag wording), and never next to alert content.
No App Store / Google Play badges. CTA = 'Try the live demo' + medx.areazeroai.com + QR. The QR is on screen 51.5-60.0 s and fully static 57.5-60.0 s.

Case codes unreadable everywhere (B-019, B-012, B-013, B-014, B-004, B-001, F-206; the Next case button in the signed-note still is painted over with the banner tint), except the patient's own synthetic pickup code B-015 in S13. On-screen record: triage level 3 confirmed by Nurse Anna Rossi; note signed by Dr. Marco Bianchi; strings match apps/mobile/src/i18n.ts.

CSS recreations (tokens and exact app copy, never invented features): S06 Thai and Italian phones; S11 allergy alert card (packages/shared/src/medrules.json messages.allergy_conflict, rule MR-ALLERGY-PEN, because every still has the sticky sign-off bar over it) and the 'Returned to prescriber: 1' chip; S12 six check titles (apps/web/app/(pharmacy)/_orders.tsx CHECK_ITEMS) and '6 of 6 confirmed'; S13 pickup counter card (apps/mobile/src/i18n.ts pickupEyebrow / pickupCounter / pickupReadyBody, because the still cuts the counter number); S14 Case trace graph (8 nodes from trace.webp); S15 state chips and ledger.
Originality: music and SFX are generated by our Python/numpy code; fonts are OFL via @fontsource; device frames are CSS; no Apple marks or trademarks; Fin is the owner-approved original mascot.
No emoji, no sparkle icons, no chat bubbles for clinical content.
